name: TCA8418 Keypad
description: The `tca8418` component allows you to use a TCA8418 keypad scanner ([datasheet](https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tca8418.pdf)) with ESPHome. The [I²C Bus](https://esphome.io/components/i2c/) is required to be set up in your configuration for this device to work.

config_entries.label: Address
config_entries.description: The I²C address of the device. Defaults to `0x34`.

config_entries.label: Interrupt Pin
config_entries.description: The pin the device's interrupt output is connected to. When set, the component leaves the device alone until the interrupt says there is something to read, instead of asking it regularly. That saves I²C traffic and processing time while the keypad is idle; it does not make a key press arrive noticeably sooner, since either way one is picked up within a few milliseconds. The output is open drain and active low, so it needs a pull-up; set `mode: INPUT_PULLUP` unless the board already has one of its own.

config_entries.label: Mode
config_entries.description: Pin mode flags (input / output / pullup / pulldown / open_drain). Combine flags as needed — e.g. input + pullup for a button pulled to VCC.

config_entries.label: Open Drain
config_entries.description: Set the open drain mode flag.

config_entries.label: Inverted
config_entries.description: Invert the logical level. ``true`` swaps high/low in software so an active-low button reads as active when grounded.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: Set the ID of this device for use in lambdas.

config_entries.label: Columns
config_entries.description:
**Set together with:** `rows` (all-or-none).

The number of columns in the key matrix, `1` to `10`. The matrix occupies the `COL` lines starting at `COL0`.

config_entries.label: Gpi Events
config_entries.description: Report the pins that are not part of the key matrix as individual inputs. Defaults to `true`.

config_entries.label: Keys
config_entries.description: The keys present on the matrix, from top left to bottom right, row by row. It must have exactly `rows` × `columns` characters. Required for `key_collector`, and for selecting a `binary_sensor` by its character.

config_entries.label: Rows
config_entries.description:
**Set together with:** `columns` (all-or-none).

The number of rows in the key matrix, `1` to `8`. The matrix occupies the `ROW` lines starting at `ROW0`. Set together with `columns`; leave both out for no key matrix.
